description: Baseline attempt failed: benchmark passed --static to CliRunner instances that do not advertise mode flags when fetch_stream/handlers are omitted.
Set up real-world pipeline autoresearch harness covering responsive/focus/profiler/live demos via CliRunner static/live paths with deterministic dimensions and zero-sleep live stream baseline.
Tried caching CliRunner argparse parser; dataclass field ordering bug (default cache field inserted before required fields) caused import-time TypeError.
Cache argparse parser inside CliRunner for repeated run() calls, avoiding parser reconstruction in benchmark loops.
Add env-size fast path in cli context detection: parse COLUMNS/LINES before shutil.get_terminal_size() to reduce repeated CLI context overhead.
Tried inlining service health style mapping in focus demo services panel to avoid helper calls; regression across focus/profiler buckets.
Optimize TestSurface frame capture by cloning Buffer once per frame and reusing snapshot for both _prev and CapturedFrame payload.
Tried lazy caching CapturedFrame.lines/text in TestSurface; added per-access branching/object.__setattr__ overhead and regressed aggregate pipeline metric.
Changed focus scenario validation to use set membership for emission kinds; slight regression overall despite marginal focus improvement.

Added requested cold-start instrumentation to benchmark harness: new secondary metrics cold_start_ms (fresh process demo runs) and cold_import_ms (fresh process import painted). Updated autoresearch.md metrics.

Separate warm and cold sampling loops in autoresearch harness: warm pipeline metrics averaged over 20 runs; cold_start/cold_import measured in isolated 5-run subprocess loop to avoid perturbing warm-path primary metric.
Optimize Buffer.clone to bypass Buffer.__init__ allocation via object.__new__, avoiding throwaway preallocated cell list during frame snapshot cloning.
Add TestSurface capture_writes toggle; skip Buffer.diff when neither ANSI output nor write capture is needed. Enable in focus demo scenarios (which only assert emissions/frames text).
Speed up TestSurface buffer_to_lines conversion by iterating contiguous Buffer._cells rows directly instead of per-cell Buffer.get() calls.
Cache parsed COLUMNS/LINES terminal size in cli context detection to avoid repeated env parsing across high-frequency run_cli invocations.
Curated focus scenario frame snapshots at fetch time (store only labeled key frames) to avoid carrying full frame lists; regressed aggregate pipeline metric.
Tried caching stdout isatty() result in cli context detection; small regression and risks stale mode detection when stdout wrapper changes.
Removed rstrip() in focus frame snapshot rendering to avoid per-line trim; regressed warm metrics and changed textual normalization behavior.
Added selective TestSurface frame capture indices and focus scenario preselection to avoid storing non-key frames; modest regression in aggregate warm metric.
Hoisted reusable Style(dim=True)/Style(bold=True) instances in focus services panel to reduce per-row allocations; slight regression on primary metric.
Refactored CliRunner dispatch to skip context-manager path when ANSI is enabled (no icon override needed); no improvement and slight regression.
Refactored focus emission rendering helpers to pass cached palette/styles (avoid current_palette()/Style allocations per emission row); no primary gain.
Reduced redundant ANSI resets in writer paths by only resetting on style transitions after first segment and adding single preamble reset; regressed warm-path metrics.
Optimized filter_fuzzy by lowercasing query once per call instead of per item match; no warm-path gain in integrated suite.
Simplified focus scenario check construction with list comprehensions (same semantics); slight regression in primary metric.
Specialized TestSurface emit-capture closure for no-upstream-callback case to remove per-emit branch; did not improve integrated benchmark.
Tried index-based buffer_to_lines row join to avoid per-row slice allocation; slight regression versus slice-based contiguous iteration.

Tried lightweight TestSurface capture mode storing precomputed text lines instead of cloning Buffer when capture_writes=False; significantly regressed focus path due extra per-frame line materialization.
Hoisted local surface/render references in TestSurface.run_to_completion loop to reduce attribute lookups; no primary improvement.
Reworked focus frame snapshot rendering to use Block.column instead of many Block.text + join_vertical calls; regressed aggregate warm metric.
Higher-leverage attempt: thread one palette instance through focus panel render helpers to avoid repeated current_palette calls in Surface render path; no primary improvement.
Higher-leverage attempt: selective frame capture in TestSurface for focus scenarios (capture only key frames, skip clone on non-captured frames when diffing disabled). Slight regression overall.
Deferred focus frame capture from fetch to _key_frames (lazy recapture only for full/detailed zoom); increased overhead and regressed focus bucket significantly.
Tried higher-leverage focus search optimization: precomputed lowercase command corpus and inline fuzzy matcher to avoid per-render item.lower() allocations; regressed primary metric.
Higher-leverage attempt: reduce Style object churn in focus render path by introducing shared STYLE_* constants across hot panel rendering. Small regression on primary metric.
Higher-leverage writer path attempt: detect color depth once per apply_style and thread into _color_codes to avoid repeated capability lookup per fg/bg. Regressed warm primary metric.
Replace Search.select_next/select_prev Cursor object construction with direct modular arithmetic; no primary improvement.
Simplified Buffer.diff to a single linear pass over cells (emit write when cell differs), removing per-row double-scan logic. Improved some secondary buckets but not primary.
Batch InPlaceRenderer clear sequence into single write (move-up + repeated clear lines + move-up) to reduce Python loop overhead; near-neutral but no primary improvement.
Add CliRunner.run fast path for empty args when no custom add_args callback: skip argparse parse and use default zoom/mode/format directly. No primary gain.
Re-tried focus scenario check construction via comprehensions + unpack to reduce append loop overhead; still no primary improvement.
Inline AUTO mode resolution inside detect_context and avoid extra resolve_mode call/is_pipe temporary; near-neutral but still above best primary metric.
Tiny hot-loop tweak in buffer_to_lines: cache list.append local while constructing lines. No primary improvement.
Precomputed static service display strings (health/p95/error) for focus services panel to cut per-render formatting; no primary gain.
Profiler extraction cleanup: compute total_writes once and derive avg from it to avoid duplicate summation; no primary improvement.
Higher-leverage live-mode change: in non-ANSI streaming contexts, bypass InPlaceRenderer and render final snapshot once after consuming stream. Improved live_stream secondary but not primary.
No-code variance rerun: observed lower pipeline_ms likely due measurement noise; discarded to avoid false keep without code change.
No-code variance rerun to estimate measurement spread after plateau; result remains near best but not a code-backed improvement.
No-code variance rerun produced best warm score but with large cold metric degradation, indicating environment noise; discarded to avoid overfitting to transient conditions.
Final no-code variance rerun (run 50/50) to bracket plateau behavior; confirms substantial run-to-run noise around the current code baseline.
TestSurface _render_and_capture local binding cleanup (surface alias + direct _needs_clear access) to reduce attribute lookups/getattr overhead; no primary gain.
Use list.copy() for Buffer.clone cell/id list duplication instead of list(...); small but consistent clone-path improvement across TestSurface-heavy workloads.
Avoid per-frame tuple() conversion for empty TestSurface writes via shared empty tuple path; no primary improvement.
Phase 2 setup: new focus-path autoresearch target with dedicated harness and cold metrics. Established baseline focus_ms across minimal/summary/full zoom workloads.
Cache palette-derived emission styles within focus summary/detailed/full renderers by passing style refs into emission block helper; modest focus_ms improvement.
